text:
emma: Heads-up — planning a rollforward to runtime 2.17 tonight at 23:00 UTC. This includes the KV-cache pointer fix and kernel reorder. Deploybot will snapshot the pinlist at 22:30 UTC. Need fast compat decisions for model groups that touch longseq/quant paths.

jordan: Is SDK 3.4.1 required for the client-side shim for 2.17? We should call that out in release notes if so.

li-chen: Canary in eu-west shows a 4% p95 latency bump for llama3q-quant when KV-cache is enabled. Memory looks stable but warmup is longer. I can dig into traces in 15m.

rafael: For embeddings-heavy customers, keep g-embed models pinned to runtime 2.16 for the first 6 hours post-roll. Otherwise we'll see token cost spikes. Propose: pin g-embed/* -> 2.16, allow unpin for text-gen groups.

ops-oncall: If we pin some groups, what's rollback window and who triggers rollback? We should set a deadman window to 01:30 UTC with automated revert if error rate > 2%.

deploybot: Automated message: snapshotting pinlist at 22:30 UTC. Current diff preview:
```
- runtime_pin: runtime:2.16 -> models: [large-chat/*]
+ runtime_pin: runtime:2.17 -> models: [nlp-safety/*]
+ soft_pin_exempt: g-embed/* (retain 2.16 until 05:00 UTC)
```

emma: Thanks. Decision: apply selective pins. Action items:
- li-chen: finalize canary trace notes and post quick repro steps by 22:00.
- jordan: update release notes to mention required SDK 3.4.1 (and fallback path) by 22:15.
- deploybot: enact soft_pin_exempt for g-embed/* at 22:30 and publish pin diff to /releases/2.17/pins.
- ops-oncall: enable deadman revert at 01:30 UTC.

li-chen: I'll capture a small prompt set that reproduces the warmup; posting now: `prompt = 'summarize long doc with chunked context'` — measured throughput drop on first 10 tokens.

jordan: For SDK fallback, add snippet to release notes:
```
# client config
runtime_preference: ["2.17", "2.16"]  # SDK 3.4.1 will attempt 2.17 then fallback
```

rafael: Sounds good. Also request we tag customers who requested pinned behavior; I'll DM CS to prepare comms.

ops-oncall: I'll set the revert policy: if 5xx rate or latency p95 >= +20% sustained for 10m, revert pinned groups automatically and page release leads.

deploybot: Confirmed: soft_pin_exempt applied at 22:30 UTC, deadman revert scheduled 01:30 UTC. Logs will appear in #release-ops and /infra/deploys.

emma: Perfect. Final ask — if anyone spots model correctness regressions during canary, post to this thread and tag me. We'll hold any further unpins until 06:00 UTC.

jordan: I'll push the SDK changelog + quick rollback snippet once build completes.

li-chen: Canary follow-up: added traces to the PR and noted a hot path in kv_refresh() at small batch sizes. Not blocking rollforward but worth tracking.

rafael: Thx everyone. I'll coordinate customer comms and keep the pinned list minimal.

deploybot: Automated message: rollforward started 23:00 UTC. Will update on completion or on fail.

emma: Closing loop — we'll reconvene in #release-ops at 23:40 UTC for post-rollcheck. :thumbsup:
